patthana15.47:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.47:2.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna sahabhuṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna sahabhū na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. (abyākatamūlakaṃ tīṇimeva.)
